title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go, parity fixes and v1.181.0 bump
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: bring SDK feature parity across Python/TypeScript/Go for auth behavior, retry semantics, streaming ergonomics, and bump package versions to v1.181.0. This unblocks consistent client behavior across environments and reduces support surface. Changes include: 1) Unified auth: single token/provider resolution path that falls back to environment variables, shared credential file, and explicit init param. 2) Deterministic retries: standardized idempotency key handling, retryable error classification, exponential backoff with jitter, and a configurable max_attempts param exposed in all SDKs. 3) Streaming ergonomics: consistent async iterator / callback surface, chunk framing normalization, and stable reconnection/retry semantics for transient network interruptions. 4) Parity fixes: align TypeScript request payload shapes with Python/Go, fix minor header casing issues, and add missing typed exports. 5) Version bumps: python (1.181.0), typescript (1.181.0), go (v1.181.0) and corresponding changelogs and CI matrix updates. Migration notes: default retry behavior is unchanged for existing users; the new unified auth will prefer explicit credentials if provided. Documentation updates and quickstart examples added. Checklist: - [x] Implement unified auth in py/ts/go - [x] Standardize retry logic and expose config - [x] Update streaming API surface and add examples - [x] Add integration tests and CI matrix - [x] Update docs and changelogs - [x] Version bumps and publish scripts Context: work consolidates multiple previous PRs (see related PRs in series) and addresses long-standing support tickets about inconsistent retry traces and streaming disconnects.
commits: feat(sdk): unify auth provider chain across languages
feat(sdk): centralize retry policy and idempotency keys
fix(streaming): normalize chunk framing and reconnect logic
chore(release): bump versions to v1.181.0 and update changelogs
test(sdk): add cross-language integration tests for streaming and retries

Ravi Shah: Can we add a small integration test that simulates a transient ECONNRESET and ensures client resumes correctly? added a test suggestion
Elena Martinez: Approved after CI green and minor doc clarifications. Noted we should monitor rollback metrics for first 24h post-release
Asha Patel: Responded that TS backoff tuned to match Python experiments; added suggested ECONNRESET test in commit; docs updated per Elena
merge_outcome: merged via squash (merge commit: feat(sdk): unify auth/retries/streaming — consolidated cross-language client behavior). Release tagging and publish workflow triggered for python/typescript/go packages.
release_notes: - SDK: unify auth provider chain across Python/TypeScript/Go for consistent credential resolution. - SDK: standardized retry semantics with configurable max_attempts, idempotency key handling, and exponential backoff with jitter. - SDK: improved streaming ergonomics — unified async iterator/callback surface, better chunk framing, and reconnection behavior for network blips. - Fixes: parity corrections in request payload shapes and header handling across SDKs. - Release: version bumps to v1.181.0 for Python/TypeScript/Go. See changelogs for migration details.
notes: Post-merge: CI published packages to internal registry and scheduled public publish for 02-02-2026. Ops will monitor client error rates and streaming reconnects in the first 48h.
